source_text: Πάντες τε ἐταπεινοφρονεῖτε μηδὲν ἀλαζονευόμενοι, ὑποτασσόμενοι μᾶλλον ἦ ὑποτάσσοντες, ἥδιον διδόντες ἢ λαμβάνοντες. τοῖς ἐφοδίοις τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἀρκούμενοι, καὶ προσέχοντες τοὺς λόγους αὐτοῦ ἐπιμελῶς ἐνεστερνισμένοι ἥτε τοῖς σπλάγχνοις, καὶ τὰ παθήματα αὐτοῦ ἦν πρὸ ὀφθαλμῶν ὑμῶν. οὕτως εἰρήνη βαθεῖα καὶ λιπαρὰ ἐδέδοτο πᾶσιν καὶ ἀκόρεστος πόθος εἰς ἀγαθοποιΐαν, καὶ πλήρης πνεύματος ἁγίου ἔκχυσις ἐπὶ πάντας ἐγίνετο: μεστοί τε ὁσίας βουλῆς, ἐν ἀγαθῇ προθυμίᾳ μετ’ εὐσεβοῦς πεποιθήσεως ἐξετείνετε τὰς χεῖρας ὑμῶν πρὸς τὸν παντοκράτορα θεόν, ἱκετεύοντες αὐτὸν ἵλέως γενέσθαι, εἴ τι ἄκοντες ἡμάρτετε. ἀγὼν ἦν ὑμῖν ἡμέρας τε καὶ νυκτὸς ὑπὲρ πάσης τῆς ἀδελφότητος, εἰς τὸ σώζεσθαι μετ’ ἐλέους καὶ συνειδήσεως τὸν ἀριθμὸν τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν αὐτοῦ. εἰλικρινεῖς καὶ ἀκέραιοι ἦτε καὶ ἀμνησίκακοι εἰς ἀλλήλους. πᾶσα στάσις καὶ πᾶν σχίσμα βδελυκτὸν ἦν ὑμῖν. ἐπὶ τοῖς παραπτώμασιν τῶν πλησίον ἐπενθεῖτε: τὰ ὑστερήματα αὐτῶν ἴδια ἐκρίνετε. ἀμεταμέλητοι ἦτε ἐπὶ πάσῃ ἀγαθοποιΐᾳ, ἕτοιμοι εἰς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθόν. τῇ παναρέτῳ καὶ σεβασμίῳ πολιτείᾳ κεκοσμημένοι πάντα ἐν τῷ φόβῳ αὐτοῦ ἐπετελεῖτε: τὰ προστάγματα καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα τοῦ κυρίου ἐπὶ τὰ πλάτη τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν ἐγέγραπτο.
pass_a_gloss: All of you humble your minds, not being arrogant, submitting rather than commanding, giving more gladly than receiving. Being content with the teachings of the Christ, and paying attention to His words carefully, having them in your hearts as if in your bowels, and His sufferings were before your eyes. Thus deep and rich peace was given to all, and an insatiable desire for doing good, and a full outpouring of the Holy Spirit came upon all: being full of holy counsel, with good readiness and pious faith, you stretch out your hands to the all-powerful God, beseeching Him to be merciful, if you sinned unwillingly. A struggle was yours day and night on behalf of all the brotherhood, to save with mercy and conscience the number of His elect. You were sincere and uncorrupted and not forgetful towards one another. All sedition and all schism was detestable to you. You mourned over the transgressions of your neighbors: you judged their deficiencies as your own. You were unrepentant regarding all good deeds, ready for every good work. Adorned with all virtue and reverent citizenship, you performed all things in fear of Him: the commandments and the righteousness of the Lord were written on the backs of your hearts.
pass_b_english: All of you kept a humble mind and refused to be arrogant, choosing to submit rather than to command, and you found more joy in giving than in receiving. You were content with the teachings of Christ and attended to His words carefully, treasuring them deep in your hearts, while His sufferings remained constantly before your eyes. Because of this, a deep and rich peace was given to everyone, an insatiable desire for doing good took hold, and a full outpouring of the Holy Spirit came upon all. Filled with holy purpose, you stretched out your hands to the Almighty God with eager readiness and reverent confidence, begging Him to show mercy if you had sinned unwillingly. Day and night you struggled for the whole brotherhood, praying that the number of His elect would be saved with mercy and a clear conscience. You were sincere, uncorrupted, and unforgetting of wrongs toward one another; every uprising and every division was detestable to you. You mourned over the transgressions of your neighbors and judged their failings as your own. You never regretted any good deed and stood ready for every good work. Adorned with all virtue and reverent conduct, you carried out everything in the fear of Him, for the Lord's commandments and righteous decrees were written on the very tablets of your hearts.

anf_compare.notes: Drafted from source only; ANF not shown to drafter.

review.notes: All clauses in the Greek source [p1] are accounted for in both Pass A and Pass B. Pass A provides a closer literal rendering of 'πλάτη τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν' (backs of your hearts) compared to Pass B's 'tablets of your hearts', but both are acceptable translations of the metaphor. Pass B's 'unforgetting of wrongs' for 'ἀμνησίκακοι' is a valid rendering of the compound. No omissions or doctrinal shifts detected.

source: "ἐταπεινοφρονεῖτε μηδὲν ἀλαζονευόμενοι, ὑποτασσόμενοι μᾶλλον ἦ ὑποτάσσοντες, ἥδιον διδόντες ἢ λαμβάνοντες." english: "All of you kept a humble mind and refused to be arrogant, choosing to submit rather than to command, and you found more joy in giving than in receiving."
